name: Sunrise Efficient Marketing Li
summary: Sunrise Efficient Marketing Ltd. provides diverse electrical, mechanical, and automation solutions. Its offerings span components like motors, gearboxes, industrial lubricants, lighting systems, drives, pumps, and electrical panels. Additionally, the company performs thorough motor rewinding services, a process encompassing data recording, removal of damaged windings, steam cleaning and insulation painting of the stator, lacing, curing, and final testing. Established in 2002, the firm is based in Surat, India.
